# Expected verdicts for the backup fixture with the forge unreachable.
# backup-expected.txt is the same fixture with pull-request lookups
# working. The reason keys are documented in expected.txt.
#
# Every backup here was taken before its story branch was squashed, and
# holds two commits that write the same line twice: its tip adds nothing
# once the story merges and its first commit still would. The story
# branches are gone; the canned records name them.
#
# branch                 verdict  reason                  why
main                     KEEP     protected:default       the default branch, and where HEAD is
